s: Dine yeshibat sukka ubo k"v seipim: "bassukkot teshebu shibat yamim", velamedu mippi hashshemua "teshebu" — keen taduru, kelomar kederek shehu dar kol hashshana bebeto — hizqiqattu tora lehanniach dirato veladur kan bassukka im mittotayv umatztzaotayv ukele tashmisho, mikkan ameru chakamim: kol shibat hayyamim adam oseh beto aray vesukkato qeba. Ketzad? Haya lo matztzaot naot vekelim naim — maalan lassukka, veken kol kele shetiyya hatztzerikim lo — yihyu immo bassukka kederek shehen immo bebeto bekol hashshana. Abal kelim shemmashhin bahen qemach vehaarebot vekelim shel mayim — enan tzerikin lihyot bassukka, sheap bekol hashshana en debarim ellu regilim lihyot immo bebet dirato, ella bayit yesh lahem bilbaddam:

Kele akila leachar akila, kegon qederot uqearot sheachar haakila hen meusin — tzarik lehotzian min hassukka. Veken deli o kad sheshshoabin bo mayim — lo yaknisem letok hassukka. Veken lo yaaseh shum tashmish bazuy bassukka, kegon shetipat qederot uqearot, kede shello yihyu mitzvot bezuyot alayv. Abal muttar lishtop kele hashshetiyya kegon kosot vetzintzaniyyot bassukka:

Hammenora beshaa shehi doleqet — tzerika lihyot betok hassukka. Veim hassukka qetanna beinyan sheyyesh lachosh shemma yitqareb hanner ledopne hassukka o lehassekak veteachez bahen haur vetissarep sukkato — tzarik lehannichah chutz lassukka, apillu hi shel zahab. Venohagin shello lehaknis ner shel cheres apillu lesukka gedola:

Ketzad mitzvat yeshiba bassukka? Sheyyihyeh okel veshoteh veyashen vitayyel vedar bassukka kol shibat hayyamim, ben bayyom ben ballayla, kederek shehu dar bebeto bishar yemot hashshana. Veim hu tzarik lesapper im chabero — yesapper immo bassukka. Kelalo shel dabar, leolam yidmeh alayv sukkato keillu hi beto, vekol dabar shello haya oseh chutz lebeto — lo yaaseh chutz lesukkato. Lepikak, kol shibat hayyamim tzarik liqrot velilmod betok hassukka (ella im ken qore velomed bebet hammidrash). Veim hu mebin umedaqdeq keshellomed — yakol lilmod chutz lassukka, kede shettehe dato meyushshebet alayv, sherochab haavir yapeh lo leharchib dato. Umikkol maqom, hakkol lepi hainyan, sheim yesh lo menucha bassukka — tzarik lilmod bassukka. Veim tzarik lilmod mittok separim harbeh, im epshar lo lehakin lahem maqom besukkato beinyan shello yitztarek lepannotam missukkato beet haakila vehashshena velachazor ulehaknisan beet hallimmud — tzarik lilmod betok hassukka, abal im i epshar lo lehakin lahem maqom beqal belo torach rab veyesh lo torach rab lepannotam velachazor ulehaknisam — yakol lilmod chutz lassukka, lepi shekkol tircha yetera sheen haadam mitztaer umonea et atzmo mittircha zo kede lesheb bebeto biqbiut — en mechuyyab litroach kede lesheb besukkato biqbiut:

Hammitpallel, im yesh lo menucha bassukka sheyyukal lehitpallel sham bekavvana — tzarik liknos lassukka ulehitpallel, shehare bishar yemot hashshana kesheeno mitpallel bebet hakkeneset hu niknas lebeto umitpallel. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemaqom sheen sham bet hakkeneset, o shei epshar lo lelek lebet hakkeneset, abal im epshar lo lelek lebet hakkeneset — yelek, veeno tzarik lehitpallel bassukka:
Hammabdil al hakkos — tzarik liknos lassukka lehabdil sham, shehare bishar yemot hashshana niknas lebeto lehabdil sham:

Okelin akilat aray chutz lassukka. Abal asur lishon apillu shenat aray chutz lassukka, lepi shebbeshena en lechalleq ben aray leqeba, shellipamim sheeno menamnem ella meat vedayyo bekak, lepikak zo hi shenat qeba shello shechayyab liknos lassukka bishbilah:

Bammeqomot haqqarim sheyyesh tzaar lishon bassukka mechamat haqqor veen lo karim ukesatot karauy en tzarik lishon bassukka. Vaapillu yesh lo karim ella shei epshar lo lehakin lahem maqom bassukka lekol shibat yeme hechag beinyan sheyyitztarek litroach lehotzian mehassukka bishat haakila velachazor ulehaknisan beet hashshena, vehi tircha yetera umitztaer betircha zo beinyan sheim haya lo tircha kazo lishon bebeto lo haya yashen bebeto — eno tzarik lishon bassukka, shekkol hammitztaer bishibat hassukka patur mishibatah kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tr"m:

Veakshav nahagu haolam lehaqel beshena, sheen yeshenim bassukka raq hamdaqdeqim bemitzvot. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut, lemi shennasuy ishsha shechayyab lesammeach et ishto baregel, venashim peturot min hassukka, im ken im eno rotzeh liprosh meishto — miqre debar mitzva, vekol haoseq bemitzva — patur mimmitzva acheret kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tr"m, veal ken hu patur mishshena bassukka ballayla, vaapillu im ishto enah tehora, mikkol maqom shayyak simcha keshebbalah mityached immah becheder echad kemo sheyyitbaer. Umikkol maqom, tob lehachamir sheyyihyeh lo sukka meyuchedet sheyyukal lishon sham im ishto viqayyem shette hammitzvot:

Hannose betula shenayim o shelosha yamim qodem hechag beinyan shennimsheku shibat yeme hammishteh shello betok hechag (deillu bachag atzmo en nosein nashim kemo shennitbaer besiman tqm"v), bayyamim harishonim shehayu nohagim shekkol shibat yeme hammishteh hayu mityachadin hechatan vehakkalla becheder meyuchad, veen shum adam niknas etzlam raq beet sherotzim lesammeach otan veleekol velishtot immahem, vezeh hacheder niqra chuppa — hare hechatan vehashshoshebinin vekol bene hachuppa dehaynu otam anashim sheokelim im hechatan peturim min hassukka kol shibat yeme hammishteh, umuttarim leekol velishtot velismoach chutz lassukka, dehaynu bacheder hanniqra chuppa, lepi shei epshar lismoach karauy betok hassukka, sheen iqqar hassimcha ella bachuppa, shehu iqqar yeshibat hechatan vekalla, dehaynu maqom shehem mityachadin sham, vei epshar laasot iqqar yeshibat hechatan vekalla betok hassukka, lepi shekkol sukka en lah raq shelosha depanot uperutza beruach rebiit ubosh sham hechatan lesacheq im kallato. Velaken akshav shennohagin laasot arba mechitztzot lassukka — ap hechatan chayyab besukka:

Kebar amarnu shemmuttar leekol akilat aray chutz lassukka. Vekamma hi akilat aray? Kebetza, shekken derek haadam litom paam achat melo piv chutz lebeto, umelo piv hu kebetza, sheen bet habbelia machaziq yoter mikkebetza. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bepat haasuya mechameshet hamminim o betabshil heasuy mechameshet hamminim, abal shear mine maakalim, veen tzarik lomar mine perot, apillu okel mehem harbeh, vaapillu qobea alehen seudato — muttar leoklan chutz lassukka, lepi sheqqebiat minim ellu enah chashuba ella kaakilat aray shel pat:

Muttar lishtot kol hammashqin chutz lassukka, apillu yayin, vaapillu shoteh yoter merebiit, vekol hammachamir al atzmo shello lishtot chutz lassukka apillu mayim — hare zeh meshubbach. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheshshoteh derek aray, abal im qobea et atzmo lishtot yayin, o shear mashqin shedderek liqboa alehen, kegon me debash veshekar bimdinot ellu shergilin liqboa alehen lishtot belo seuda — tzarik liknos letok hassukka. Abal en tzarik lebarek "lesheb bassukka", lepi shehashshetiyya hi tepela laakila ubirkat "lesheb bassukka" shebberak al akilat shacharit hi poteret et hashshetiyya shel kol hayyom, veken hi poteret et hashshena vetiyyul bassukka kol hayyom, sheen tzarik lebarek alehem, sheapillu yatza chutz lesukkato achar haakila vehipsiq harbeh ben haakila lehashshetiyya veshena vetiyyul, mikkol maqom kevan shekkullam nimshakim utepelim laakila shehi iqqar mitzvat hayshiba bassukka — birkat haakila potartam. Vaapillu shoteh veyashen umetayyel qodem haakila — en tzarik lebarek, lepi shehen tepelim lehaakila shelleacharehem:

Veim haya qabua lishtiyya bassukka venimlak leekol, ap al pi shello haya tzarik lebarek "lesheb bassukka" al hashshetiyya lepi shebbirkat haakila shellepaneha potartah — ap al pi ken tzarik lebarek "lesheb bassukka" al akila zo haacharona, sheen akila zo tepela laakila harishona, ella hi chashuba bipne atzmah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyatza min hassukka ben gemar akila rishona lehatchalat akila acharona veshaha sham chutz lassukka velo chazar lealtar ella leachar shaa ushettayim, o apillu im chazar lealtar ella shebbeshaa sheyyatza min hassukka haya dato lishhot harbeh chutz lassukka veshello lachazor lassukka lealtar, sheaz en habberaka shebberak al akila harishona poteret akila acharona, kevan shehipsiq benehen bitzia gemura al daat shello lachazor lealtar. Abal im lo hipsiq benehem bitzia gemura shello lachazor lealtar — eno tzarik lebarek al akila acharona. Vaapillu hu kol z' yamim betok hassukka, im lo yatza mimmenna yetzia gemura shello lachazor lealtar — en tzarik lebarek "lesheb bassukka", raq bappaam harishon shenniknas lassukka:

Vekol zeh keshenniknas leotah sukka shebberak bah baakila rishona, abal im niknas lesukka acheret, apillu hi beoto chatzer semuka lassukka shebberak bah baakila rishona, kesherotzeh leekol besukka zo dabar sheasur leoklo chutz lassukka — tzarik lachazor ulebarek "lesheb bassukka", apillu im hi beinyan sheen tzarik lebarek birkat hannehenin al akila zo, kegon shehu omed beemtza seudato sheakal bassukka shebberak bah uposeq seudato vehalak leekol besukka acheret — tzarik lachazor ulebarek:

Vaapillu im eno rotzeh leekol besukka zo ella shenniknas letokah lishon uletayyel — tzarik lebarek "lesheb bassukka", sheen shena vetiyyul shebbesukka zo niptarin babberaka shebberak besukka acheret. Abal im niknas letokah leekol betokah mine maakalim shemmuttar leoklan chutz lassukka — en tzarik lebarek. Veim rotzeh liqboa et atzmo sham lishtot yayin ushear mashqim shedderek liqboa alehem min haddin — tzarik lebarek, shehare asur lishtotan chutz lassukka. Umikkol maqom, lepi sheyyesh mepaqpeqin al beraka zo, laken nakon haddabar shello liqboa et atzmo bishtiyya, raq bassukka sheakal bah hayyom uberak aleha "lesheb bassukka":

Im shakach lebarek "lesheb bassukka" ad sheggamar seudato — yebarek leachar seudato. Veap al pi shekkol hammitzvot tzarik lebarek alehen ober laasiyyatan, mikkol maqom hare gam hayshiba sheyyosheb bassukka achar hasseuda hu gam ken biklal hammitzva, veim ken hare hu mebarek qodem asiyyat hammitzva:

En qitzba lisudot shel sukka, ella im yirtzeh yokal bassukka, veim yirtzeh lo yokal raq mine maakalim shemmuttar leoklan chutz lassukka, sheen hammitzva ella sheim yokal lo yokal chutz lassukka. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechullo shel moed, abal beyom tob ubeshabbat shehu betok hechag shechayyab leekol pat yoter mikkebetza kemo shennitbaer besiman ratz"[a] — tzarik leekol betok hassukka. Veim yaredu geshamim — hare zeh niknas letok habbayit, veal derek sheyyitbaer. Bammeh debarim amurim? Millayla harishona shel chag vaelak, abal ballayla harishona shel chag, dehaynu lel t"v betishre, — tzarik leekol betok hassukka apillu bishat haggeshem. Veap al pi shehu mitztaer mechamat haggeshem, vekol hammitztaer patur min hassukka, mikkol maqom ballayla harishona — chayyab leekol bassukka, lepi sheanu lemedin bigzera shava mechag hammatztzot: neemar kan bechag hassukkot "bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh", veneemar lehallan bechag hammatztzot "bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh", mah t"v yom haamur lehallan layla harishona choba leekol kezayit matztza kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"h — ap t"v haamur kan choba leekol bassukka. Ubaakilat kezayit betok hassukka yotze yede choba, kemo sheyyotze baakilat kezayit matztza. Abal mikkol maqom, chayyab leekol od pat babbayit, shehare bekol seudat yom tob choba leekol yoter mikkebetza pat, ella shebbetok hassukka bishat haggeshem — en choba leekol yoter mikkezayit, kemo baakilat matztza. Vaapillu shello bishat haggeshem, im yirtzeh leekol kezayit bassukka ukebetza metzumtzemet tok habbayit — hareshut beyado, ella shehammachamir leekol kol hasseuda betok hassukka shello bishat haggeshem — hare zeh meshubbach kemo shennitbaer lemala:
Kesheokel bishat haggeshem bassukka — tzarik gam ken leqaddesh al hayyayin betok hassukka, shehare en qiddush ella bimqom seuda, vibarek "lesheb bassukka" qodem "shehecheyanu" kemo im lo haya geshem:

Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim shebbekol seudot shabbat veyom tob en tzarik leekol pat raq kezayit, veim ken beyom tob veshabbat shebbetok hechag im yirtzeh shello leekol raq kezayit uleoklo chutz lassukka — hareshut beyado. Vedabar zeh anu lemedin bigzera shava mechag hammatztzot shechoba leekol bassukka ballayla harishona, abal en lemedin bigzera shava zo sheyyihyeh choba leekol ap bishat haggeshem, shekkevan shehu mitztaer mechamat haggeshamim hu patur min hassukka ap ballayla harishona. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kassebara harishona bekol zeh, mikkol maqom belel sheni shel galuyyot kevan sheeno ella minhag shehare anu beqiim biqbiut hachodesh — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona veeno tzarik leekol bassukka bishat haggeshem. Umi sherotzeh lehachamir al atzmo gam belel sheni kassebara harishona — eno tzarik leqaddesh bassukka, ella yeqaddesh veyokal kol seudato betok habbayit, veachar haakila yiknos lassukka veyokal sham kezayit velo yebarek "lesheb bassukka":

Vekevan sheakilat layla harishona nilmad bigzera shava meakilat matztza — tzarik lihyot domeh lah bekol dabar, dehaynu shello yokal beereb yom tob min hammincha ulemala kede sheyyokal bassukka leteabon, velo yokal bassukka ad leachar tzet hakkokabim, veyizzaher leekol qodem chatzot layla, hakkol kemo baakilat matztza kemo shennitbaer behilkot pesach:

Meematay muttar lippanot min hassukka mippene haggeshamim? Bishar seudot hechag, chutz millayla harishona, mishshaa sheyyaredu kol kak tippot tippot letok hassukka sheim hayu nopelim letok tabshil shel pol sheddarko lemaher lehitqalqel bemayim muatim haya hattabshil mitqalqel — hare zeh yotze min hassukka, ap al pi sheen lepanayv tabshil bassukka. Umi sheeno baqi beshiur zeh — yeshaer im hayu yoredim kol kak geshamim letok habbayit im haya yotze min habbayit yotze gam ken min hassukka:

Vekol zeh baakila, abal beshena en tzarik leshaer bikde sheyyitqalqel hattabshil, shebbigshamim muatim yesh tzaar lishon sham, veyukal latzet mehassukka, shekkol hammitztaer patur min hassukka. Ukeshem shemmuttar lippanot min hassukka mippene haggeshamim — kak muttar lippanot mippene hashsharab o mippene hayyattushim, apillu en haadam mitztaer bekak ella shehattabshil mitqalqel bekak, veken im haet qor shehammaakalim hashshemenim niqrashim bassukka — okel kol seudato babbayit:
Kol happatur mishibat hassukka veeno yotze mehassukka — eno meqabbel sakar al oto yeshiba, veeno ella min hahedyotot:
Hayyotze mehassukka mippene haggeshamim — al yibat veyetze, ella yetze behaknaa, keebed shebba limzog kos lerabbo veshopeko lo rabbo al panayv, kelomar eni chapetz beshimmusheka:
Haya okel bassukka veyaredu geshamim vehalak lebeto ligmor seudato ukesheyyashab lo leekol pasequ haggeshamim — en mechayyebin oto lachazor lassukka ligmor seudato, ella gomer seudato bebeto:

Haya yashen betok hassukka veyaredu geshamim veniknas letok habbayit ligmor shenato vead shello shakab pasequ haggeshamim — tzarik lachazor lassukka. Abal im kebar shakab betok habbayit veachar kak pasequ haggeshamim — eno tzarik lachazor lassukka, ella yashen bebeto kol oto hallayla. Vaapillu heqitz mishshenato qodem sheala ammud hashshachar — en matrichin oto lachazor lassukka ligmor sham shenato, ella muttar lo ligmor shenato bebeto. Vaapillu kebar ala ammud hashshachar vehu adayin yashen betok habbayit — en tzerikim lehaqitzo mishshenato, ella mannichin oto lishon ad sheyyinnaer meelayv. Veim heqitz mishshenato leachar sheala ammud hashshachar verotzeh lachazor velishon — tzarik lelek letok hassukka velishon sham, kevan shekkebar ala ammud hashshachar:
